SLAYTHEMDEADLYSINS-BOLLO.title: Bollo
SLAYTHEMDEADLYSINS-BOLLO.talk.firstVisit: Never bet on avoiding my attention
SLAYTHEMDEADLYSINS-BOLLO.talk.ANY.0-0r.a: Does chance favour you today, do you think?
SLAYTHEMDEADLYSINS-BOLLO.talk.ANY.1-0r.a: Cuting across the fabric of fate again?
SLAYTHEMDEADLYSINS-BOLLO.talk.DEFECT.0-0: What foolish hand does Neow play by sending me a broken automaton?
SLAYTHEMDEADLYSINS-BOLLO.talk.DEFECT.1-0:
And how am I supposed to play a game of chance with one who is himself so...


[thinky_dots]DETERMINISTIC?[/thinky_dots]
SLAYTHEMDEADLYSINS-BOLLO.talk.DEFECT.2-0: The architect said [thinky_dots]WHAT[/thinky_dots] about foreseeing your arrival[thinky_dots]??[thinky_dots]
SLAYTHEMDEADLYSINS-BOLLO.talk.IRONCLAD.0:
[sine]Ahhh, The Ironclad.
I have it on [red]good authority[/red] that you are one to appreciate a good deal.[/sine]
SLAYTHEMDEADLYSINS-BOLLO.talk.IRONCLAD.1: You rush forward so blind with rage your actions might as well be entirely decided by chance
SLAYTHEMDEADLYSINS-BOLLO.talk.IRONCLAD.2: Neow? She would use you, as she uses all...
...The Architect? He would remove you, not to interfere with his grand designs...
[jitter][b]BUT I? I WOULD UNLEASH YOU UPON THE WORLD SO A NEW ONE MAY HAVE A CHANCE TO ARISE FROM THE ASHES[/b][/jitter]
SLAYTHEMDEADLYSINS-BOLLO.talk.SILENT.0-0: A hunt is but a game with [red]lives at stake[/red], little gambler.
SLAYTHEMDEADLYSINS-BOLLO.talk.SILENT.1-0: Your sisters tried to cheat, I know. Were they any good at it, one of them would be my little knife now, not you
SLAYTHEMDEADLYSINS-BOLLO.talk.SILENT.2-0: Time and time again, you outplay us one and all by refusing to cheat
SLAYTHEMDEADLYSINS-BOLLO.talk.SILENT.2-2: Were I not as impressed, I would hate you for it, my little ace in the hole
